services.value: Provides fully equipped mobile laboratory services for real-time on-site analysis of water, soil, and hazardous waste samples to support environmental investigations, remediation, and compliance. Testing includes NELAP certified analytical support with VOC (8260), SVOC (8270), PCB (8082), and GRO & DRO (TPH) petroleum hydrocarbon analyses, with Level III (and upon request Level IV) data reporting.
